headlines.title: What Could Chinese Import Curbs Mean For Lumentum Holdings (LITE)?
headlines.summary: Lumentum Holdings (NasdaqGS:LITE) is in focus as Washington drafts new limits on Chinese optical transceiver imports for data centers. The proposed U.S. rules target data center equipment sourced from Chinese vendors, including high speed optical modules used in AI and cloud networks. Domestic optical component suppliers could see increased demand as large U.S. data center operators reassess sourcing away from restricted Chinese imports.

headlines.title: Lumentum Is Down 33% in a Month as Marvell’s Slide Shrinks Its Buyout Value. Can LITE Stock Get Back to Bernstein’s $700 Target?
headlines.summary: Lumentum posted record revenue and a blockbuster outlook, yet its stock keeps sinking anyway. A fixed-ratio merger clause ties its fate to someone else's share price, and that changes what a recovery would actually require.

headlines.title: Applied Optoelectronics Sinks 9% on $550 Million Stock Sale Plan; Coherent and Lumentum Rise 4%
headlines.summary: Record revenue, a blockbuster hyperscale deal, and still the market flinched. Applied Optoelectronics keeps returning to investors for cash, and while rival optics names climb, one CFO comment hints at why this funding pattern has traders on edge.

description: Lumentum Holdings Inc. manufactures and sells optical and photonic products in the Americas, the Asia-Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. It offers component products, including semiconductor laser chips, laser sub-assemblies, line subsystems, and wavelength management systems. The company also offers system products, such as optical modules, optical circuit switches, and industrial lasers, including short-pulse solid-state lasers and kilowatt-class fiber lasers. Its products and solutions are used in cloud, artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML), telecommunications, consumer, and industrial end-market applications. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
